say:1:1831107001:1.text: Ah! Excuse me, do you happen to know where the flower shop on Crescent Street is?
say:1:1831107001:1.source_cn: 啊，不好意思，请问你知道月弯街上的花店在哪里吗？
say:1:1831107001:1.male: Ah! Excuse me, do you happen to know where the flower shop on Crescent Street is?
say:1:1831107001:1.female: Ah! Excuse me, do you happen to know where the flower shop on Crescent Street is?

say:2:1831107002:1.text: I'm not a Grave—ahem, I mean, I'm not a local. My husband wrote to me with this address, so I'm not really sure how to get there...
say:2:1831107002:1.source_cn: 我不是亡……唔，我不是本地人。这个地址是我丈夫写信告诉...
say:2:1831107002:1.male: I'm not a Grave—ahem, I mean, I'm not a local. My husband wrote to me with this address, so I'm not really sure how to get there...
say:2:1831107002:1.female: I'm not a Grave—ahem, I mean, I'm not a local. My husband wrote to me with this address, so I'm not really sure how to get there...

say:3:1831107003:1.text: It's obvious this anxious woman is a stowaway, likely visiting family here in Novaris.
say:3:1831107003:1.source_cn: 很显然，眼前这位拘谨的女士是偷渡者，大概率是来诺珐斯探亲的。

choice_prompt:4:1831107003.text: It's obvious this anxious woman is a stowaway, likely visiting family here in Novaris.
choice_prompt:4:1831107003.source_cn: 很显然，眼前这位拘谨的女士是偷渡者，大概率是来诺珐斯探亲的。

say:5:1831107004:0.text: ... Thank you. I guess my disguise still needs some work.
say:5:1831107004:0.source_cn: ……谢谢。看来我的伪装还是有点差呀。
say:5:1831107004:0.male: ... Thank you. I guess my disguise still needs some work.
say:5:1831107004:0.female: ... Thank you. I guess my disguise still needs some work.

say:7:1831107005:0.text: You take the letter she hands you and check the details. However, a line catches your eye.
say:7:1831107005:0.source_cn: 你接过她递来的信纸，查看上面的详细地址。然而，无意间瞥...
say:7:1831107005:0.male: You take the letter she hands you and check the details. However, a line catches your eye.
say:7:1831107005:0.female: You take the letter she hands you and check the details. However, a line catches your eye.

say:8:1831107006:1.text: "Once you arrive, you'll know who was responsible for separating us."
say:8:1831107006:1.source_cn: ——“等你抵达那里，就会知道是谁造成了我们的分离”。

say:10:1831107007:0.text: Acting natural, you point out the location of the flower shop on Crescent Street. Maybe you should follow her and check it out yourself, just in case this stowaway catches the guards' eyes.
say:10:1831107007:0.source_cn: 你不动声色地为她指出了月弯街花店的位置。也许你也该过去...
say:10:1831107007:0.male: Acting natural, you point out the location of the flower shop on Crescent Street. Maybe you should follow her and check it out yourself, just in case this stowaway catches the guards' eyes.
say:10:1831107007:0.female: Acting natural, you point out the location of the flower shop on Crescent Street. Maybe you should follow her and check it out yourself, just in case this stowaway catches the guards' eyes.

choice:4:1:2.text: I won't report you, don't worry.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我不会举报你是偷渡者的
choice:4:1:2.male: I won't report you, don't worry.
choice:4:1:2.female: I won't report you, don't worry.

say:0:1831108001:0.text: You murderer... You're the one who killed Rovo!
say:0:1831108001:0.source_cn: 你这杀人犯……就是你杀了罗沃！
say:0:1831108001:0.male: You murderer... You're the one who killed Rovo!
say:0:1831108001:0.female: You murderer... You're the one who killed Rovo!

say:1:1831108002:0.text: That sounds like the woman who asked for directions earlier...
say:1:1831108002:0.source_cn: 这声音像是之前找我问过路的那个偷渡者……出了什么事？
say:1:1831108002:0.male: That sounds like the woman who asked for directions earlier...
say:1:1831108002:0.female: That sounds like the woman who asked for directions earlier...

say:2:1831110001:1.text: I can't believe the one who killed Rovo was you! <shk>You were brothers!</shk>
say:2:1831110001:1.source_cn: 我真不敢相信……害死罗沃的人竟然是你！<shk>你们明...

say:3:1831110002:1.text: Stop spouting nonsense! I died way before Rovo did! How could I have killed him?!
say:3:1831110002:1.source_cn: 黛菲比，你不要血口喷人！我死得可比罗沃早多了，怎么可能...

say:4:1831110003:1.text: Then how do you explain his right arm and left leg being attached to your body?!
say:4:1831110003:1.source_cn: 那你怎么解释……他的右手臂和左腿出现在你身上的原因？！

say:5:1831110004:1.text: I drew those tattoos on him myself back when we were together! I'd recognize them anywhere!
say:5:1831110004:1.source_cn: 他身上的纹身，都是我和他恋爱时我亲手画给他的图样！我绝...

say:6:1831110005:1.text: And he explained everything in the letters he sent me... You couldn't find suitable limbs to replace your own, so you set your sights on him... That's why you wrote to him and asked him to come to Novaris to visit you!
say:6:1831110005:1.source_cn: 而且他寄给我的信里都写清楚了……你是因为买不到合适的肢...

say:7:1831110006:1.text: He didn't die in some accident on his way back to the Lightbearer Empire... You murdered him!
say:7:1831110006:1.source_cn: 他根本不是在返回耀光的途中遭遇意外的……就是你杀了他！

say:8:1831110007:1.text: Y-you're talking nonsense! Rovo died in a shipwreck! It was an accident! They couldn't even find his body!
say:8:1831110007:1.source_cn: 你、你胡说八道什么！罗沃就是意外遇到海难去世的，连尸体...

say:9:1831110008:1.text: E-even if my arm did come from him, how could he possibly have written you a letter?! Stop talking nonsense!
say:9:1831110008:1.source_cn: 就……就算是我现在的手臂来自于他，那他怎么可能还给你写...

say:10:1831110009:1.text: Even if he only had one arm and one leg left, he would never forget about me!
say:10:1831110009:1.source_cn: ——就算他只剩一条手臂一条腿，他也绝不可能忘记我！

say:11:1831110010:1.text: And... I'm going to avenge him!

narration:12:1831110011:1.text: Daphine furiously scuffles with Thornton. You rush forward to pull them apart.
narration:12:1831110011:1.male: Daphine furiously scuffles with Thornton. You rush forward to pull them apart.
narration:12:1831110011:1.female: Daphine furiously scuffles with Thornton. You rush forward to pull them apart.

narration:13:1831110012:1.text: With the help of the guards who arrive, the two are finally pulled apart.
narration:13:1831110012:1.male: With the help of the guards who arrive, the two are finally pulled apart.
narration:13:1831110012:1.female: With the help of the guards who arrive, the two are finally pulled apart.

say:17:1831110014:1.text: Under Novaris law, you're looking at a violation of a living person's right to life, desecration of a corpse... well, probably a few other charges, but those two alone are enough to lock you up for a hundred years.
say:17:1831110014:1.source_cn: 桑顿，根据诺珐斯的法规，你的行为涉及侵犯生者的生命权、...

say:18:1831110015:1.text: No... that's not fair! On what grounds?! She doesn't even have any evidence!
say:18:1831110015:1.source_cn: 不……不是！凭什么啊？！她都没有拿出证据！

choice_prompt:19:1831110015.text: No... that's not fair! On what grounds?! She doesn't even have any evidence!
choice_prompt:19:1831110015.source_cn: 不……不是！凭什么啊？！她都没有拿出证据！

say:21:1831110017:1.text: Save it. We're all Graveborn here, who are you trying to fool? Luring living people to Novaris just to harvest their limbs isn't anything new around here.
say:21:1831110017:1.source_cn: 行了，大家都是亡灵，你想骗谁啊？骗生者来到诺珐斯，再取...

say:22:1831110018:1.text: Though your memory overlap seems pretty severe. You didn't even notice your own right hand secretly writing those letters?
say:22:1831110018:1.source_cn: 不过你的记忆混淆症状挺严重啊，连自己的右手悄悄写信都没...

say:23:1831110019:1.text: I told you, I didn't write them!

say:24:1831110020:1.text: Alright, zip it. Don't think becoming a Graveborn excuses you from following the law. It wouldn't fly in Bantus either!
say:24:1831110020:1.source_cn: 好了，闭嘴吧。别以为变成亡灵就不用遵纪守法了，就算你去...

say:25:1831110021:1.text: Oh, right. Before sentencing, I need to take you to the Repair House for surgery. We'll confiscate all the illicit gains you obtained from the victim and return them to the victim's family.
say:25:1831110021:1.source_cn: 哦对了，在判刑之前，我得带你去修缮屋做手术，把你从受害...

say:27:1831110023:1.text: What are you waiting for? Move!

say:0:1831111001:0.text: I might as well follow them and see what happens.
say:0:1831111001:0.source_cn: 他们要去修缮屋？那我也跟上去看看。
say:0:1831111001:0.male: I might as well follow them and see what happens.
say:0:1831111001:0.female: I might as well follow them and see what happens.

say:2:1831113002:1.text: He was punished! I avenged you...
say:2:1831113002:1.source_cn: 桑顿……他受到惩罚了！我替你报仇了……

say:3:1831113003:1.text: You can finally... finally rest in peace...
say:3:1831113003:1.source_cn: 你总算……总算可以瞑目了……呜呜呜……

say:8:1831113007:1.text: I-I'm here! Rovo... I knew it was you!
say:8:1831113007:1.source_cn: 我、我在这里！罗沃……我知道是你！

say:9:1831113008:1.text: I missed you so much... Rovo... I've missed you all this time...
say:9:1831113008:1.source_cn: 我好想你……罗沃……我一直都很想你……呜呜呜……

say:12:1831113011:1.text: The ghost drifts to Daphine's side and wraps its insubstantial arms around her. Then, slowly, it fades away.
say:12:1831113011:1.source_cn: 模糊的幽灵飘到黛菲比身旁，用虚无的手臂环抱着她。然后…...
